properties.name: picsure.operations.internal-token
properties.description: Shared secret that InternalTokenFilter requires on the X-PIC-SURE-INTERNAL-TOKEN header for every /internal/** request. Maps from the QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN environment variable. Fail-closed: when blank, every /internal/** request is rejected with 403, even one carrying a header value.

properties.name: picsure.operations.result-type-backfill.enabled
properties.description: Whether ResultTypeBackfill runs one pass on a background thread after startup. The pass stores the result type on query rows that have none, derived from each row's stored body, and writes no other column. When false, no thread is started and no row is read.

properties.name: picsure.operations.result-type-backfill.batch-size
properties.description: The largest number of query rows ResultTypeBackfill reads in one page. Each row is written in a transaction of its own, whatever the page size. A value below 1 stops the service from starting.

properties.name: picsure.operations.result-type-backfill.pause
properties.description: How long ResultTypeBackfill waits between two pages of query rows. A negative value stops the service from starting.
